title: Tokyo private charter for Mt. Fuji, Hakone and more on KKday
price_note: Read on 8 October 2026: from US$197.66 on some dates and from US$513.92 on others for a one-day charter; overtime is charged on top.

not_included: Overtime fees (5,000 JPY per hour up to 14 seats, 10,000 JPY per hour for larger)
facts.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 3 days before the date; no cancellation within 2 days

summary: A private car with a driver for one or several days around Tokyo, Mt. Fuji and Hakone, with 7-, 10- or 19-seater vehicles and tolls and parking included.
body:
## What this is

This is a private car charter around Tokyo, sold by KKday. You book a vehicle and a driver for the day, or for several days, and decide the route yourself or follow a recommended one to Mt. Fuji, Lake Kawaguchiko, Hakone and other places. You can start as early or late as you like within the service hours.

## Vehicles

The listing offers a luxury 7-seater for up to six passengers and two checked bags, a comfy 10-seater for nine passengers and nine bags, and a comfy 19-seater for eighteen passengers. The price rises with the vehicle size.

## What is and is not included

The price covers the vehicle, the driver, fuel, a driver meal allowance, expressway tolls and parking fees. It does not cover personal expenses, admission fees, the Mt. Fuji 5th Station access fee or parking at Arakurayama Sengen Park. Overtime is charged at 5,000 JPY per hour for vehicles with up to 14 seats and 10,000 JPY per hour above that.

## The driver's language

The driver language is listed as Mandarin and Japanese. English is not listed, so it suits you if you are happy to navigate with those languages or with your own plan in hand.

## Prices and cancellation

The price shown was from US$197.66 for some dates and from US$513.92 for others, so check your date before you plan. Free cancellation applies up to 3 days before the date, and orders cannot be cancelled or changed within two days of it.

## Where it can take you

Besides downtown Tokyo, the listing's itinerary options include Mt. Fuji and Hakone, Kamakura, Karuizawa and Nikko, Atami and Izu, Yokohama, Saitama and Kawagoe, and Chiba.

## When it fits

It suits a family or small group that wants one flexible day out of Tokyo without handling trains. For a single traveller the fare is high compared with trains and tours.
